senses.definition: To toilet paper; to throw toilet paper in rolls over a structure, so the structure becomes draped with it.
An abstract item of corporate bureaucracy.
senses.example:
Bill Lumbergh: Hello, Peter. What's happening? Ah, we have sort of a problem here. Yeaaah, you apparently didn't put one of the new cover sheets on your TPS reports?
Peter Gibbons:
Who has not accidentally written a "tpyo"?
